neighbours.label: a parenthetical interrupter in the middle of a clause (the comma or 'however' / 'though' of 'It is, ...', 'too soon, however,')
fire: The report is, in the words of one critic, a masterpiece of evasion.
Too much screen time at night, however, can ruin a child's sleep.
The museum was, by all accounts, the finest in the region.
Long walks after dinner, though, are said to help digestion.
His argument is, to be blunt, a complete misreading of the law.
The second album, however, sold far fewer copies than the first.
This approach is, as the author admits, rather expensive to run.
The early reviews were mixed; the sales, though, were excellent.
quiet: The report is a masterpiece of evasion according to one critic.
Too much screen time at night can ruin a child's sleep.
The museum was considered the finest in the region by visitors.
Long walks after dinner are said to help digestion.
His argument is a complete misreading of the law, says the judge.
The second album sold far fewer copies than the first one did.
This approach is rather expensive to run according to the author.
The early reviews were mixed and the sales were excellent.

notes: Card top: 'It is,' x3, ' though' x10, ' however', 'more like'. Probe: 'The film is, to put it mildly' 0.20, 'however' 0.11; versions without the interrupter ~0.01-0.07. Weak; low confidence.
